description: CRM framework layer — contacts/companies/deals/activities/stages schema, configurable pipeline, stage-move endpoint, won-amount-by-month reporting.

firstSteps: Run pnpm db:generate then pnpm db:migrate to create tables
Run pnpm dev — the server starts on PORT (default 8104)
POST a Pipeline row first, then Stages, before creating Deals
GET /health to confirm the server is up
apiRoutes: POST /api/deals (create a deal in a stage)
POST /api/activities (call / email / meeting linked to contact+deal)
dataModels: Contact (firstName, lastName, email, phone, title, companyId nullable, ownerUserId)
Stage (pipelineId, order, name, probability, isClosedWon, isClosedLost) — configurable
Deal (title, amountCents, currency, stageId, contactId, companyId, ownerUserId, expectedCloseAt, wonAt, lostAt)
Activity (type: call|email|meeting|note|task, occurredAt, summary, dealId nullable, contactId nullable, ownerUserId)
DealStageHistory (dealId, fromStageId, toStageId, movedAt, movedByUserId) — audit of pipeline progression
architectureNotes: Stages are configurable rows, not an enum — let users reorder / rename / add stages without migrations
Won/lost deals set wonAt or lostAt timestamp + stage flag; reports filter on those
Stage transitions write a DealStageHistory row so velocity reports (avg days per stage) are possible
Amounts are integer cents — avoid float, avoid NUMERIC-vs-bigint lossiness
gotchas: Email uniqueness across contacts is a business decision. Multiple contacts can share an email (shared inboxes, spouses at same B2C account) — do NOT make email UNIQUE without product confirmation.

Deal amounts in integer cents, not NUMERIC(10,2). Multi-currency deals need a currency column per deal; do NOT convert at write time, convert at report time so historical rates don't corrupt the past.
Pipeline stages are user-editable. Queries that hard-code stage names will break the moment a user renames 'Qualified' to 'MQL'. Query by stage.id or by stage flags (isClosedWon).
Merging duplicate contacts/companies is a critical CRM feature this starter does NOT implement. Bad merges destroy activities and deals — add a reversible merge log before wiring a merge button.
GDPR / CCPA: contacts are personal data. Right-to-erasure must soft-delete and preserve activity records anonymized. Hard-deleting a contact cascades and loses historical deals — don't.
Activity timestamps are the source of truth for 'last contacted'. Background ingestion (email sync, calendar sync) must use the real send/meeting time, not the import time.
Closed deals are immutable for revenue reporting. Allow editing TITLE / NOTES but do NOT allow editing amount or stage on a deal where wonAt IS NOT NULL without an audit trail + a correction log.
